claim: the eight named products are: Aladdin, Aladdin Wealth, eFront, Aladdin Studio, Aladdin Data Cloud, Aladdin Copilot, Aladdin Accounting, Aladdin Provider (identity of the eight)
earlier_receipt: https://www.blackrock.com/aladdin nav: "Aladdin", "Aladdin Wealth", "eFront", "Preqin" (Platforms) and "Accounting", "Aladdin Studio", "Aladdin Data Cloud", "Whole Portfolio", "Risk Management", "Sustainability", "Climate Risk", "Aladdin Copilot", "Private Markets Data" (Solutions). https://www.blackrock.com/aladdin/platforms/products/aladdin-accounting heading "Aladdin® Accounting". https://www.blackrock.com/aladdin/platforms/products/aladdin-provider heading "Aladdin® Provider" and "connects asset managers and asset servicers through a single platform – Aladdin."
earlier_finding: All eight names are real BlackRock products. The list is the author's selection, not BlackRock's set. It leaves out the top-level platform Preqin and the solutions Whole Portfolio, Risk Management, Sustainability, Climate Risk and Private Markets Data. Label the list as a selection, or add Preqin.

Its only eFront mention: "This expansion brings together Aladdin technology with Preqin and eFront data and analytics". Support from other pages: https://www.efront.com/en: "With Preqin® inside, eFront® Insight makes private markets investing more seamless and more informed."; https://www.preqin.com/news/blackrock-aladdin-launches-end-to-end-private-markets-workflow: "eFront Insight combines pre-investment data from Preqin® with eFront's post-investment workflows and risk analytics."; https://www.blackrock.com/aladdin/discover/press-release/blackrock-aladdin-drives-private-markets-transparency: "In eFront, institutional clients can now manage their full investment lifecycle in one place, with detailed market context via Preqin data."
earlier_finding: The fact is true, but the citation is wrong. Cite the BlackRock press release of 5 Feb 2026 (or efront.com) for this clause, and keep 13 for the May 2026 clause. Optionally write 'Preqin data now sits inside eFront Insight', because Preqin is still sold as its own product.
